label: 24 ct drag v1
definition: Re-registration of the ercot_ct_drag_v1 bundle (same solve as 2026-06-30-24-ct-drag-v1: ercot 23 base + ct_netload_drag=True, slope 0.00703/intercept -0.1427/cap 0.47/ramp 15-22h LST, + CC_REGULAR econ_high delta -0.13) with an updated dashboard payload after fixing scripts/render_calibration_html.py's ERCOT guard, which previously hard-excluded ERCOT from the C3c fallback tail-hour computation; C3c now falls back to model_price_by_zone when no ORDC overlay file exists for the year, so 2025 price-tail scores instead of SKIPPED (model 6h vs actual 31h > $200, ratio 0.19x). This surfaces a CAVEAT that was previously hidden, pushing the soft-caveat count to budget. Determination: NOT-YET (caveat budget exceeded: hard 2/1, soft 3/3) — hard caveats are C1 fuel-mix CC_REGULAR/CC_CHP classification split (2023/2024) and C2 gas system volume 2025 (-3.2%, EIA-923 preliminary vintage gap); soft caveats are C3b price-shape (2023/2024) and the newly-scored C3c price-tail (2025). All caveats are pre-existing, attested measured-input limitations, not new regressions.
